committeeMembersItems.name: Prof. M. Farhaan Makba
committeeMembersItems.title: President
committeeMembersItems.bio: Prof. M. Farhaan Makba is the President, Education Portfolio Committee at MESCO. He completed his M.Sc. in Microbiology and Post Graduate Diploma in Management of Education. Presently is an Assistant Professor, Department of Microbiology at Royal College, Mira Road. He was also awarded R.S Krishnan CUBE-Teacher fellow award by TIFR.

committeeMembersItems.name: MR. MASUD MEMON
committeeMembersItems.title: Vice-President
committeeMembersItems.bio: Mr. Masud Memon is the Vice-President of MESCO, a Commerce graduate from Mumbai University. He is a businessman by profession.

committeeMembersItems.name: MR. SALMAN KARDAME
committeeMembersItems.title: General Secretary
committeeMembersItems.bio: Mr. Salman Kardame (General Secretary) of MESCO is an Arts Graduate from Mumbai University. He did his Vocational Training in Computers. An Entrepreneur dealing in Computer Hardware and Software. He is also into Construction Business. He is the Chairman of the R. C. Mahim Portfolio Committee at MESCO.

defaultProps.description: MESCO is a Secular Trust registered in 1968 with the Charity Commissioner of Mumbai. The organization is a selfless effort for serving mankind which began with a few friends who constituted the first Managing Committee. ‘Education’ was identified as a core theme for human development by the organization and later it expanded to provide Medical Assistance and Poverty Relief. The organization touches the lives of over 15,000 families annually through a combination of well strategized and implemented schemes, programs, activities and its institutions. The approach has always been to uphold ethical values in delivering and becoming a channel to deliver resources from those who want to giveto those who need it the most.

animationsTextParagraphs.text: MESCO is a Secular Trust registered in 1968 with the Charity Commissioner of Mumbai. The organization is a selfless effort for serving mankind which began with a few friends who constituted the first Managing Committee. 'Education' was identified as a core theme for human development by the organization and later it expanded to provide Medical Assistance and Poverty Relief. The organization touches the lives of over 15,000 families annually through a combination of well strategized and implemented schemes, programs, activities and its institutions. The approach has always been to uphold ethical values in delivering and becoming a channel to deliver resources from those who want to give to those who need it the most.
